findings: Best observed strategy: one_d_budget=0.25, lm_laplace_seconds=1800, tv_max_step=0.5, original data covariance, Gaussian prior, and TV off; all five new MAPs converged.

Observed composite score was 0.488758693431 versus initial baseline 1.0; the initial baseline used tv_max_step=0.25, so that cross-run comparison is confounded. Iteration 3 versus iteration 1 isolates the LM-time change because both used step 0.5.
Mean original-covariance reduced chi-square was 315.0210 to 85.3220; pooled Rh/Rv log10 RMSE was 0.6529911 to 0.5759367.
A 0.32 1D budget admitted one 1D MDA increment but index 34 did not converge; UADP/UADA variance multipliers 2 and 4 improved field RMSE while substantially worsening data fit.
See findings.md and mda-variants.md for existing prior/TV/2D-extension evidence and the MDA-family literature taxonomy.

config.goal: Find an optimal strategy for combining 0D, 1D and 2D simulations in the transition zone, index 30-35, using an MDA-type approach coupled with Laplace; lower data misfit and Rh/Rv field RMSE against benchmark truth.
config.metric: Equal-weight normalized geometric mean of mean original-covariance reduced chi-square and pooled Rh/Rv log10 RMSE across indices 30-35; nonconverged/missing MAPs receive a 1e6 + count penalty.
